name: Restaurant, café, bakery
settings: a top-down wooden table in a Kigali restaurant
a night venue terrace with warm lights
a counter with pizza boxes ready for delivery
a home kitchen with a pan of food steaming
offers: LUNCH TIME promo, Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 2 PM
cta: Order on {app} or call {phone}; the area (Kicukiro Sonatube, Kimironko).
longestRunning: Magic Chef Kigali runs one dish per video (fish, fried chicken) with the same two delivery numbers in every caption (7+ ads); Best Burgers shows one burger, one price (PROMO FOR 5K) and two numbers for the whole clip.

name: Phone and electronics shop
settings: the shop counter with boxed phones and a wall of brand logos
a seller holding the phone in the shop
hands turning two phones to show front and back
offers: DM now before stock ends (only when stock is really limited)
cta: WhatsApp or call {phone}; the shop address and room number (Makuza Peace Plaza, Room 35).
longestRunning: Real staff, real stock and the exact shop address (Dannybabalo, Galaxy S26 Ultra) build trust where phone scams are common; the number stays on screen for the whole clip (kigaliphones).

name: Salon, barber, nails, beauty
settings: the salon chair with a ring light
close-ups of hands braiding
a 2x2 grid of nail colours
the salon sign and mirrors
offers: special offer any style {price} (inclusive of braids & free wash)
cta: Book on WhatsApp {phone}; the street (Roysambu, Lumumba Drive style).
longestRunning: SPOT SALON (Nairobi) has run one flat price that includes a free wash, written on the picture over braids being done, for 982 days in three variants; Tawali Glamour sells 'home service' with a slideshow of finished nails (508 days).
gaps: No Rwandan salon ad yet in the research; the patterns come from Nairobi and Johannesburg.

name: Fashion, boutique, shoes, bags
settings: a real wearer outdoors in daylight
a clothes rack in the boutique
a mannequin showing the detail
boxes of new arrivals being opened
cta: Send a WhatsApp message {phone}; the shop area.
longestRunning: A 5 s loop of one model walking (Modesees, 353 days) and four colours in 10 s on a real wearer (NILA BABY SHOP, 439 days) are enough; Trendy.Wear.Kigali shows one feature (a breastfeeding opening) for the whole clip with the price in the caption.

name: Real estate (sale and rent)
settings: the gate and the front of the house at golden hour
a smooth gimbal walk-through of the living room, kitchen and bedrooms
the plot-size sign and the parking
the view from the terrace over the Kigali hills
cta: WhatsApp {phone}; district, sector and street (Kicukiro, Kanombe, Kabeza); the property ID.
longestRunning: Hills Props opens with a three-panel location stack (KIGALI KICUKIRO / KANOMBE KABEZA / MWITUNDA) then '4 BEDROOMS' and '373SQM', with a Kinyarwanda spec caption and the price 130,000,000 RWF; Samkay puts 'One bedroom In Gasogi Full furnished 400k / Month' on screen from frame 0.
gaps: The highest-liked tours are American luxury homes (gimbal at dusk); Kigali tours in the research are 15 to 90 s Facebook ads.

name: School, training, courses
settings: a teacher in uniform pointing at the lesson
a classroom with students working
a notepad list filled from frame 0
cta: WhatsApp {phone} to register; the campus area.
longestRunning: Fluently's 'Don't say / Say' lesson (122K likes, 6.2K shares) is a before/after in one frame; a numbered English to Kinyarwanda list keeps people to the end.
gaps: No Rwandan school or training ad in the Ad Library sample; only lesson reels.

name: Car rental, cars, transport
settings: the real fleet parked in the compound
a car driving on a Kigali road
the interior and the boot opened
cta: WhatsApp / Call {phone}, burned in from second 1 to the end.
longestRunning: homeofhybrid (Kigali) has run 468 days with a flat template slide, raw phone footage of the cars in a compound, one word sticker per beat and a permanent yellow phone bar.
gaps: One advertiser only; more car rental ads would firm this up.

name: Clinic, pharmacy, health
settings: the doctor in a white coat in the real consulting room
the clinic front and its sign
the reception desk
cta: Call or WhatsApp {phone} (two numbers); the address with a landmark (Gishushu, Lemigo Hotel).
longestRunning: Derma Skin Clinic Rwanda runs 15+ variants since March 2026: a named doctor explains one condition in 60 s, boxed captions, the address and two numbers in every caption, the WhatsApp button; English and Kinyarwanda versions.
gaps: Health claims and before/after are restricted: education and booking only.

name: Events, venues, hotels, gifts
settings: the hall dressed and lit before guests arrive
a terrace with tables set
a grid of four gift options
offers: Free hall and free decoration, you only pay for food and drink
longestRunning: One Click Hotel (Kigali) offers the hall and decoration free, paying only for food and drink, in Kinyarwanda (85 days); flowerbar_zanzibar's 5 s grid 'BIRTHDAY GIFT OPTIONS' ran 652 days.
gaps: The One Click Hotel video did not load; only its text was read.

name: Services (cleaning, repair, delivery, printing, garage)
settings: the team at work on site
the workshop with the tools
the finished job held still
cta: Call or WhatsApp {phone}; the areas served.
longestRunning: A salon renovation time-lapse got 415.7K likes; Ando's POV panic-then-rescue story sells a delivery app in 12 s; a branding stamp sells with a macro demo and the price (RWF 5,000).

name: Shop (general retail, cosmetics, kitchenware, wholesale)
settings: a tidy shop counter in a Kigali shop
a wall of stock with a hand holding one item
the shop floor with a greeting assistant
boxes of new stock
cta: WhatsApp {phone}; the shop's building and room number.
longestRunning: The cash-on-delivery sellers (Kenlina-B, Ugalina, TnzStore) run one template for up to 24 months: flag + 'Now available', the gadget doing its job, tick-point benefits, 'Free delivery, pay after delivery'; in Kigali, EHA 250 and Eguriro keep the price and the number on screen from frame 0.
